workerBenchmark.kind: Node worker; synthetic ten-minute replay; parsed result cloned to caller

historicalFailures: Initial runs exposed a publication-response cancellation race, which is fixed and regression tested. Harness iterations corrected device instrumentation order, dialog readiness, browser-driver selection and closed-peer counting. An earlier concurrent Edge run had a local preparation timeout on reload; the later standalone run passed. Interrupted/dev-reload runs do not supply acceptance metrics.

productionDecision.decision: Owner approved production readiness despite the recorded verification gaps.
productionDecision.availability: Replay support is included in every environment; deployment remains a separate operation.

featureGateRemoved.decision: Owner requested unconditional replay availability and removal of the feature gate.

unverifiedFollowUps: Safari on macOS with five participants and active conferencing.
